lead: `bun nv proofs` reads the class cards from `target/debug/nvs.exe`, which `bun nv verify` does not rebuild, so a card you just added still reads as owed `help`.
body: Verify builds `target/covws/<host triple>/debug/nvs`, and `nvs agent show` there already prints the new card. Pass `--nvs target/covws/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/debug/nvs.exe` to `bun nv proofs --owed` before you conclude the card did not land.
